words.definition: A large and densely populated urban area
words.definationTranslation: Ek bada aur ghna aabadi wala shahri kshetra

sentence.sentence: The metropolis is a hub of economic activity.
sentence.translation: Mahānagar arthik gatividhiyon ka kendra hai.

sentence.sentence: The city's metropolis is home to many cultural institutions.
sentence.translation: Shahar ke mahānagar mein kai saanskritik sansthan hain.

words.definition: Relating to or characteristic of the suburbs
words.definationTranslation: Upanagar se sambandhit ya uske lakshanon wali

sentence.sentence: The suburban area is experiencing rapid growth.
sentence.translation: Upanagar kshetra tezi se vikas kar raha hai.

sentence.sentence: Suburban areas often have lower population densities.
sentence.translation: Upanagar kshetron mein aabadi ghnatva aksar kam hota hai.

words.definition: The process of wealthier people moving into a poorer area
words.definationTranslation: Dhanni logon ka garib ilake mein aane ka prakriya

sentence.sentence: Gentrification has led to increased property values.
sentence.translation: Uchchikaran ke kaaran sampatti ke mulya badh gaye hain.

sentence.sentence: The gentrification of the neighborhood has driven out long-time residents.
sentence.translation: Ilake ki uchchikaran ne purane niwasiyon ko bahar nikaal diya hai.

words.definition: A person who moves from one place to another
words.definationTranslation: Ek vyakti jo ek sthan se doosre sthan par jaata hai

sentence.sentence: The migrant workers face many challenges in the city.
sentence.translation: Shahar mein pravasi majdooron ka saamna kai chunautiyon se hota hai.

sentence.sentence: The migrant community has made significant contributions to the urban economy.
sentence.translation: Pravasi samuday ne shahri arthvyavastha mein mahatvapoorn yogdan diya hai.

words.definition: The study of language in relation to society
words.definationTranslation: Samaj ke sandarbh mein bhasha ka adhyayan

sentence.sentence: Sociolinguistics explores the relationship between language and culture.
sentence.translation: Samajik bhasha vigyan bhasha aur sanskriti ke beech sambandh ka anveshan karta hai.

sentence.sentence: The field of sociolinguistics has shed light on language use in urban areas.
sentence.translation: Samajik bhasha vigyan kshetra ne shahri kshetron mein bhasha upyog par prakash dala hai.

words.definition: Having or showing a varied and sophisticated culture
words.definationTranslation: Vividh aur parishkrit sanskriti wala

sentence.sentence: The city is a cosmopolitan hub with people from all over the world.
sentence.translation: Shahar vishwajanin kendra hai, jahan duniya bhar ke log aate hain.

sentence.sentence: The cosmopolitan atmosphere of the city is reflected in its cuisine.
sentence.translation: Shahar ki vishwajanin vatavaran uske vyanjanon mein prateet hota hai.

words.definition: A group of people who have been dispersed from their original homeland
words.definationTranslation: Ek samuh jo apne mool desh se vistaarit ho gaya hai

sentence.sentence: The diaspora community has maintained strong ties with their homeland.
sentence.translation: Pravasi samuday ne apne mool desh ke sath majboot sambandh banaye rakhe hain.

sentence.sentence: The diaspora has played a significant role in shaping the cultural identity of the city.
sentence.translation: Pravasi samuday ne shahar ki saanskritik pehchaan ko aakaar dena mein mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhai hai.

words.definition: The process of global integration and interconnectedness
words.definationTranslation: Vishwabandhan aur antar-sambandh ka prakriya

sentence.sentence: Globalization has led to increased economic interdependence among nations.
sentence.translation: Vishwakaran ke kaaran rashtron ke beech arthik parasantha badh gayi hai.

sentence.sentence: The process of globalization has transformed the urban landscape.
sentence.translation: Vishwakaran ka prakriya ne shahri bhoomika ko parivartit kiya hai.

words.definition: The process of people moving from rural areas to cities
words.definationTranslation: Logon ka graam se shahar ki or jaane ka prakriya

sentence.sentence: Urbanization has led to increased population growth in cities.
sentence.translation: Shahrikarshan ke kaaran shaharon mein aabadi vriddhi badh gayi hai.

sentence.sentence: The urbanization process has brought about significant changes in the social and economic landscape.
sentence.translation: Shahrikarshan prakriya ne samaajik aur arthik bhoomika mein mahatvapoorn parivartan laaye hain.

words.definition: The process of making someone or a group feel unimportant
words.definationTranslation: Kisi vyakti ya samuh ko asamarth mahasoos karne ka prakriya

sentence.sentence: The marginalization of certain groups has led to social and economic inequality.
sentence.translation: Kuch samuhon ka bahishkar samajik aur arthik asamanta ka kaaran ban gaya hai.

sentence.sentence: The process of marginalization has been a major challenge for urban planners.
sentence.translation: Bahishkar ka prakriya shahri yojanakaron ke liye ek badi chunauti rahi hai.

words.definition: The presence of many different cultures in a single society
words.definationTranslation: Ek hi samaaj mein kai alag-alag sanskrtiyon ka hona

sentence.sentence: Multiculturalism has enriched the urban cultural landscape.
sentence.translation: Bahusanskriti ne shahri saanskritik bhoomika ko samriddh banaya hai.

sentence.sentence: The city's multiculturalism is reflected in its diverse neighborhoods.
sentence.translation: Shahar ki bahusanskriti uske vividh ilaakon mein prateet hoti hai.

words.definition: The process of becoming similar to the surrounding culture
words.definationTranslation: Aas-paas ki sanskriti ke saath milne ka prakriya

sentence.sentence: Assimilation has been a challenge for many immigrant communities.
sentence.translation: Samaveshan kayi pravasi samudayon ke liye ek chunauti rahi hai.

sentence.sentence: The process of assimilation has helped to create a more cohesive society.
sentence.translation: Samaveshan ka prakriya ne ek adhik samriddh samaaj banane mein madad ki hai.

words.definition: Extending or operating across national boundaries
words.definationTranslation: Rashtriya seemaon se pare ya unke aarthik kshetra mein

sentence.sentence: Transnational corporations have significant influence on the global economy.
sentence.translation: Aantar-rashtriya corporationon ka vishwa arthvyavastha par mahatvapoorn prabhav hai.

sentence.sentence: The transnational movement of people has shaped the urban cultural landscape.
sentence.translation: Aantar-rashtriya sthar aur logon ke gatividhiyon ne shahri saanskritik bhoomika ko aakaar diya hai.

words.definition: Not having a formal or official structure
words.definationTranslation: Aavdhik ya adhikarik sanrachna ka abhav

sentence.sentence: Informal economies thrive in many urban areas.
sentence.translation: Anauddhik arthvyavastha kayi shahri kshetron mein prabhavit hoti hai.

sentence.sentence: The informal sector has become a significant source of employment in the city.
sentence.translation: Anauddhik kshetra shahar mein rojgar ka ek mahatvapoorn strot ban gaya hai.

words.definition: The ability to maintain or support a process without damaging the environment
words.definationTranslation: Prakriya ko banaaye rakhne ya uska samarthan karna bina paryavaran ko nuksaan pahunchaye

sentence.sentence: Sustainability is a key challenge for urban planners in the 21st century.
sentence.translation: Sthirata 21vi shatabdi mein shahri yojanakaron ke liye ek mahatvapoorn chunauti hai.

sentence.sentence: The city's sustainability initiatives have improved the quality of life for its residents.
sentence.translation: Shahar ki sthirata abhiyanon ne niwasiyon ke jeevan ka star badhaya hai.

words.definition: The ability to withstand or recover from difficult conditions
words.definationTranslation: Kathin paristhitiyon ka saamna ya usse ubharne ki kshamta

sentence.sentence: Resilience is a key factor in determining the success of urban projects.
sentence.translation: Samarthan shahri pariyojanon ke safalta ka ek mahatvapoorn kaarak hai.

sentence.sentence: The resilience of the city's residents has helped them cope with natural disasters.
sentence.translation: Shahar ke niwasiyon ka samarthan unhein prakritik aapdaon se nipatne mein madad karta hai.

words.definition: The state of being unequal or uneven
words.definationTranslation: Asamanta ya avyavasthita ka sthiti

sentence.sentence: Inequality is a major challenge facing urban communities.
sentence.translation: Asamanta shahri samudayon ke saamne ek badi chunauti hai.

sentence.sentence: The city's inequality has led to social and economic disparities.
sentence.translation: Shahar ki asamanta ka kaaran samajik aur arthik asamanta ka utpann hua hai.

words.definition: The act of separating people or things into distinct groups
words.definationTranslation: Logon ya vastuon ko alag-alag samuhon mein baantne ka kaarya

sentence.sentence: Segregation has been a persistent issue in urban areas.
sentence.translation: Praathmikaran shahri kshetron mein ek sthayi samasya rahi hai.

sentence.sentence: The segregation of communities has led to social and economic inequality.
sentence.translation: Samudayon ka praathmikaran ka kaaran samajik aur arthik asamanta ka utpann hua hai.

words.definition: A poor area of a city where people from a particular group are forced to live
words.definationTranslation: Shahar ka ek garib ilaaka jahan kisi vishisht samuh ke logon ko rehne par majboor kiya jata hai

sentence.sentence: The ghetto has been a site of poverty and social inequality.
sentence.translation: Basti garibi aur samajik asamanta ka sthal rahi hai.

sentence.sentence: The ghetto has been a challenge for urban planners to address.
sentence.translation: Basti shahri yojanakaron ke liye ek chunauti rahi hai.

words.definition: A very poor and overcrowded area of a city
words.definationTranslation: Shahar ka ek bahut garib aur adhik aabadi wala ilaaka

sentence.sentence: The slum is a challenge for urban development.
sentence.translation: Basti shahri vikas ke liye ek chunauti hai.

sentence.sentence: The slum has been a site of poverty and social inequality.
sentence.translation: Basti garibi aur samajik asamanta ka sthal rahi hai.

words.definition: The state of being diverse or composed of different kinds of things
words.definationTranslation: विभिन्न प्रकार की चीजों से बना होने की स्थिति

sentence.sentence: The city's heterogeneity is reflected in its diverse cultural practices
sentence.translation: शहर की विविधता उसकी विभिन्न सांस्कृतिक प्रथाओं में परिलक्षित होती है

sentence.sentence: The heterogeneity of the population leads to a wide range of social and economic issues
sentence.translation: जनसंख्या की विविधता सामाजिक और आर्थिक मुद्दों की एक विस्तृत श्रृंखला की ओर ले जाती है

words.definition: Relating to the study of the characteristics of a population
words.definationTranslation: एक जनसंख्या की विशेषताओं के अध्ययन से संबंधित

sentence.sentence: The demographic changes in the city have significant implications for urban planning
sentence.translation: शहर में जनसांख्यिकीय परिवर्तन शहरी योजना के लिए महत्वपूर्ण परिणाम हैं

sentence.sentence: The demographic data is essential for understanding the social and economic trends of a region
sentence.translation: एक क्षेत्र के सामाजिक और आर्थिक रुझानों को समझने के लिए जनसांख्यिकीय डेटा आवश्यक है

words.definition: The quality of having a spatial existence or extent
words.definationTranslation: एक स्थानिक अस्तित्व या विस्तार होने की गुणवत्ता

sentence.sentence: The spatiality of the city affects the way people interact with each other
sentence.translation: शहर की स्थानिकता लोगों के आपसी संवाद को प्रभावित करती है

sentence.sentence: The concept of spatiality is crucial in understanding the urban environment
sentence.translation: शहरी वातावरण को समझने में स्थानिकता की अवधारणा महत्वपूर्ण है

words.definition: The basic systems and structures that a country or organization needs to function
words.definationTranslation: एक देश या संगठन को काम करने के लिए आवश्यक मूल प्रणाली और संरचनाएं

sentence.sentence: The infrastructure of the city is in need of major repairs
sentence.translation: शहर की आधारभूत संरचना को बड़ी मरम्मत की आवश्यकता है

sentence.sentence: The government has invested heavily in the infrastructure of the rural areas
sentence.translation: सरकार ने ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों की आधारभूत संरचना में भारी निवेश किया है

words.definition: The ability to move freely and easily
words.definationTranslation: स्वतंत्र रूप से और आसानी से घूमने की क्षमता

sentence.sentence: The city's public transportation system provides mobility to its citizens
sentence.translation: शहर की सार्वजनिक परिवहन प्रणाली अपने नागरिकों को गतिशीलता प्रदान करती है

sentence.sentence: The lack of mobility in the rural areas hinders economic development
sentence.translation: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में गतिशीलता की कमी आर्थिक विकास को बाधित करती है
